name: agentarmy-fuseki-ontology
description: Apache Jena Fuseki 5 + the AgentArmy ontology toolchain, as one image: TDB2 store, Jena CLI (shacl/sparql/riot/tdb2.tdbloader), pyshacl + rdflib (Python), ROBOT (OBO workflow). Built from eclipse-temurin + the official Apache Jena tarballs (no third-party image dependency). Implements an ontology pipeline — a 'sieve' that accepts ONLY SHACL-conformant input and emits structures/knowledge-graphs via SPARQL CONSTRUCT. Realizes ARC-ADR-019 (Ontology + Reasoning Layer).

secrets.name: fuseki_admin_password
secrets.description: Fuseki admin password (only /$/* admin endpoints; the dataset is open in dev).

shims.note: Adds Python ontology toolkit (pyshacl as a second SHACL impl, rdflib for scripts); ROBOT JAR pulled from ontodev release; Jena CLI tools extracted from the matching apache-jena tarball so server + tools share a version.

baked.purpose: Dispatch: server (default, TDB2 /knowledge dataset) | sieve | emit | shacl | sparql | riot | robot | pyshacl | <cmd>.
Strict ingest: SHACL-validate → on conformance, load via Graph Store Protocol; on violation, reject with the report (the 'sieve').
Knowledge emission: SPARQL CONSTRUCT/SELECT against the dataset, emits JSON-LD / Turtle / GraphML.
Minimal demo SHACL shapes used by the doctor (a Person with ex:name [1..1]).
Demo conformant data (the sieve must accept).
Demo non-conformant data (the sieve MUST reject — proves the strict gate).

doctor.description: Hits /$/ping, runs the sieve against bundled good/bad fixtures + shapes (asserts accept and reject), then SPARQL-CONSTRUCTs the loaded triples back as JSON-LD.

deploy.notes: Stateful TDB2 store needs persistent storage; ACA with a mounted Azure Files volume, or AKS with a PVC. Copy into the spoke to build/push.

contract.note: Upstream W3C SPARQL 1.1 Protocol + Graph Store Protocol — the contract callers bind to. AgentArmy-authored pipeline conventions (sieve + emit) live in the entrypoint + scripts/.
Ontology-pipeline contract (SHACL-only ingest, CONSTRUCT-based emission) is documented prose; formalize as a Data Products contract if it stabilizes.
